en-US.activeTasks: Finish this project’s active tasks on the source computer
en-US.pendingDelivery: Records on the source are waiting for delivery
en-US.linked: Parent, child, or linked projects need the same owner
en-US.shared: This project shares records with another scope and cannot move separately
en-US.missing: Referenced records are missing. Sync the required data first.
en-US.ambiguous: A reference matches more than one record
en-US.external: Referenced records differ between computers. Check the copies first.
en-US.size: Project data exceeds the transfer size limit
en-US.format: The data formats are incompatible. Check the version on both computers.
en-US.changed: Transfer data changed after verification. Check both computers.
en-US.board: The destination has an independent board
en-US.projectGrant: Restore this computer’s project permission on the host
en-US.waitingParticipant: Waiting for the other computer to pair again
en-US.pendingHire: Resolve the outstanding recruitment on the source computer
